backbone: fixed mean of B_support_pair seeds 20260905 and 20260906; weights frozen
selection: 0.35*(old_validation_d2t_AP+old_validation_t2d_AP)+0.15*(old_validation_d2t_R20+old_validation_t2d_R20); both measured validation APs and both old-drug validation APs must not fall more than 0.01 below frozen V3
checkpoint_zero: exact frozen V3 is eligible, retained unless validation selection improves
variant_selection: mean validation selection across all three seeds; ties choose simpler variant
training_labels: original V3 train explicit binary observations only; no project MoA labels fitted
primary_validation: 52 project old drugs assigned validation in original V3 split; complete 384-target panel, reverse candidates only these 52 drugs
secondary_validation: all original V3 validation observed pairs, drug- and target-macro AP
test_release: only after all variants, epochs, seeds and winner fixed; historical test and old-drug scopes are retrospective development regression, not untouched external confirmation
